evidence.title: Arc: economic OS for the internet (mainnet launch post)

why: Launch post, section 'Live and liquid markets from launch', names KyberSwap among protocols that 'expand access across spot trading, ... and crosschain execution' and closes 'The assets, markets, tools, ramps, and access points are all live and ready to use.' Router 0x6131…37b5 code first appears 2026-09-15 09:59 UTC (pre-launch window, via rpc.mainnet.arc.io getCode); KyberSwap blog 2026-09-20 confirms Arc live on its interface.

evidence.title: Arc: economic OS for the internet (mainnet launch post)

why: Launch post: 'Crosschain interoperability: Aleo (via xReserve), Across, Bungee, Eco, Fast, LayerZero, Relay, Socket, and Stargate connect Arc to the broader multichain ecosystem.' followed by 'The assets, markets, tools, ramps, and access points are all live and ready to use.' EndpointV2 was deployed 2026-06-01 (private pre-launch window), so contracts alone do not date the public launch.

Mainnet release names LI.FI among 'Onchain trading and liquidity protocols' that 'expand access across spot trading, structured products, perpetuals, and crosschain execution'; launch blog lists it under 'Live and liquid markets from launch'. LiFiDiamond deployed 2026-05-26 (pre-launch window). KyberSwap blog (2026-09-20) also says LI.FI 'announced Arc support from mainnet launch'.

evidence.title: Lift Launch Factory V4 on Arc explorer (creation block 21077993)

why: Launch Factory V4 (listed in lift.fun/config.js) first has code at block 21077993, 2026-09-16 01:18:52 UTC (found via rpc.mainnet.arc.io getCode binary search; explorer.arc.io and arcscan.app blocked by Cloudflare). The earlier Launch Factory 0x3f29…9153 dates from 2026-09-10 (pre-launch window), so public go-live can be no earlier than launch day.
Mainnet release lists MetaMask among digital wallets that 'put Arc’s markets within reach of hundreds of millions of existing users from day one.'
status_quote: Digital wallets: Binance Wallet, Bitget Wallet, Gate Web3, Kucoin Web3, Ledger, MetaMask, OKX Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, and Trust Wallet put Arc’s markets within reach of hundreds of millions of existing users from day one.

why: Not live at launch: the 2026-09-16 launch blog says MoonPay 'will be enabling internet-scale settlement'. Only dated source of the go-live is a KuCoin/MarsBit news relay published 2026-10-10 03:16 UTC saying Arc 'announced on X that MoonPay has launched on Arc'; the Arc X post itself (likely 2026-10-09 UTC) could not be fetched (X/nitter blocked, web search budget exhausted). MoonPay API usdc_arc record createdAt 2026-09-16 is a config timestamp, not a launch.

evidence.title: Morpho blog: Morpho is live on Arc as its credit infrastructure

why: Own post published 2026-09-16 10:48 UTC: 'What's live on day one Morpho Blue on Arc: Anyone can earn variable-rate yield or open a variable-rate borrow position on Arc'. Press release same day: 'Aave and Morpho anchor Arc's onchain credit markets at launch'. Morpho Blue core deployed 2026-05-22 (pre-launch window).

evidence.title: MURMUR token on Arc explorer (creation block 21309521)

why: MURMUR token, linked from muros.live, first has code at block 21309521, 2026-09-17 09:54:27 UTC (rpc.mainnet.arc.io getCode binary search; explorer blocked by Cloudflare). It is the only contract the project lists.
Mainnet release lists OKX Wallet among digital wallets live 'from day one'; launch blog repeats it. OKX DexRouter deployed 2026-09-11 (pre-launch window).
status_quote: Digital wallets: Binance Wallet, Bitget Wallet, Gate Web3, Kucoin Web3, Ledger, MetaMask, OKX Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, and Trust Wallet put Arc’s markets within reach of hundreds of millions of existing users from day one.

evidence.title: Steakhouse DeFi Markets Update: Steakhouse Goes Live on Arc

why: Own weekly update published 2026-09-22: 'Steakhouse Goes Live on Arc with Prime USDC and EURC. We deployed two new vaults ... on Arc'. It is a weekly roundup, so the real go-live may be anywhere 2026-09-16..22; the 2026-09-16 release names Steakhouse as 'supporting the ecosystem' at launch, and vault 0xbeef…7298 has code since 2026-06-18 (pre-launch window).
No dated source found: synthra.org and app.synthra.org give no Arc launch date or Arc contract list; X not reachable.

No dated launch announcement found (site has none; X not reachable). Tolly's own API (api.tollylabs.com/tokens) shows its earliest token TOLLY created 2026-08-02 22:44 UTC, inside the private pre-launch window, so on-chain data does not show a public go-live date.

Docs (ubi.fun/docs/integrate/contracts) list contracts from deployment block 12226732 = 2026-07-26 01:33 UTC, inside the private pre-launch window, so contracts don't show a public go-live. Docs date only the UBI coin: 'UBI launched on September 27, 2026 at 14 UTC' (token code at 2026-09-27 13:43 UTC); that is the coin, not the platform.

UnitFlowV3Factory (listed at docs.unitflow.finance/docs/dev/contracts) first has code at block 21068735, 2026-09-16 00:00:41 UTC; V3Router and Genesis Pass NFT followed by 00:05 UTC (rpc.mainnet.arc.io getCode; explorer blocked). The Normal Unit Factory V2 dates from 2026-09-12 (pre-launch window).
